title: Too good!
body: I have started using this app just 1 week ago, and I love it. The community and the encouragement is really nice. The daily mood tracker that pops up, the hack that comes up. I love it all. Yes there are improvements that are needed specially in the backlogs feature. I am eagerly waiting for that!
